name.es: Concejo de la Villa de Pinecrest

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Pinecrest Village Council took from November 8, 2022 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 60 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The list goes back to November 2022, when Fairman took office; minutes were read for every meeting from December 2, 2022. Campaign reports are counted from 2020. 8 more actions benefit a party the record does not name, so they are not listed or counted.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Villa de Pinecrest entre el 8 de noviembre de 2022 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 60 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La lista se remonta a noviembre de 2022, cuando Fairman asumió el cargo; se leyeron las actas de todas las reuniones desde el 2 de diciembre de 2022. Los informes de campaña se cuentan desde 2020. Otros 8 actos benefician a una parte que el registro no nombra, así que no se muestran ni se cuentan.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vilaj Pinecrest te pran ant 8 novanm 2022 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 60 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis la kòmanse an novanm 2022, lè Fairman te pran pòs li; nou li pwosè-vèbal chak reyinyon depi 2 desanm 2022. Nou konte rapò kanpay depi 2020. 8 lòt aksyon benefisye yon pati dosye a pa nonmen, kidonk nou pa montre yo ni konte yo.

gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Fairman was elected unopposed and sworn in Nov 8, 2022 (Dec 13, 2022 minutes). Minutes Dec 2, 2022 to Dec 10, 2024 were read from the clerk minutes PDFs attached to later Legistar agendas. Minutes of Jan 10, Jan 18 and Feb 13, 2023 and of the Nov 16, 2023, Feb 7, 2024, Aug 27 and Dec 3, 2024 workshops record no private-party actions. No meetings were held Nov 2022 between the election and Dec 2.

2022-2024 consent items carry the single consent-agenda vote. Items the minutes record as approved by "consensus" during reports (HIP Program donations) are shown with every member present voting yes, as the minutes state the Council authorized unanimously.

2022-2024 excluded: interlocals with Miami-Dade County, Coral Gables and FDOT, grant acceptances, the Moskowitz Family Foundation donation to the police (2022-69, a gift to the village), budget and code ordinances, the village-owned 11855 SW 60 Ave land use and rezoning, deferrals (Frontier Building Mar 19, 2024; Urban Robot May 7, 2024), vice mayor selections, and two June 13, 2023 roundabout sculpture resolutions (2023-53, 2023-54) whose vendor is left blank in the minutes
Minutes not yet posted (they will be attached to the next regular agenda); agenda items listed with roll null

Special meeting agenda lists an offer of judgment and a settlement offer in Megladon Inc. v. Village of Pinecrest; no minutes for this special meeting were attached to any later agenda (the Feb 10, 2026 packet contains minutes of a Jan 9 workshop instead)
Special site meeting (115 Street between 70 Avenue and 69 Court) has no minutes posted; no action items on its agenda
Legistar API carries no votes, movers or tallies for Pinecrest; all votes come from the clerk minutes PDFs
Workshops and attorney-client executive sessions (Megladon litigation, 2025-07-15 through 2026-07-14) were read; they record no actions on private parties
Roll calls cover the five members present; McDonald (interim, from May 2026) replaced del Prado, whose column is null after April 2026
The Jan 14, 2025 minutes header misprints the year as 2024; dated 2025-01-14 here
Applicants for the Pinecrest Business Alternative District expansion (10420 SW 77 Avenue, 10500 SW 77 Court) are not named in the minutes
